Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed to manage polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) because it improves how the body responds to insulin. PCOS affects about 1 in 10 women of reproductive age and is often marked by insulin resistance, in which the body doesn't respond well to insulin, prompting the pancreas to produce more. This excess insulin drives up androgen (male hormone) production, worsening symptoms like irregular periods, infertility, acne, and excess hair growth. Metformin helps by lowering insulin levels, decreasing the liver's glucose production, improving glucose uptake by muscles, and reducing circulating androgen levels as well, which can support more regular ovulation and menstrual cycles.

C. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
